fun_facts: CeeDee Lamb grew up in Richmond, Texas, and attended a game at the Cowboys’ stadium as a kid.
At Foster High School, CeeDee Lamb spent hours with quarterback Alex Ramart during spring and summer seasons.
At Oklahoma, CeeDee Lamb was a first-team All-American in 2019, catching 62 passes for 1,327 yards and 14 touchdowns; his catches and yards were both fifth-best nationally.
In 2023, CeeDee Lamb broke the Cowboys’ single-season records for receptions and receiving yards, with 135 catches for 1,749 yards.
In a 2026 game, CeeDee Lamb’s 17 catches were the most by a player since Keenan Allen had 18 in 2023.

basis.reasoning: ESPN’s biography identifies Oklahoma as CeeDee Lamb’s college.
